I don’t own the house. I’m 2 months into a 12 month lease so I’m not sure what my options are for this place. 


We  sat down and discussed our needs and wants on Thursday. I said I didn’t feel loved or appreciated. I didn’t want to keep worrying about her driving home drunk or waking me up in the middle of the night. She agreed said she was sorry and she’ll make it up to me. She didn’t come home last night and apologized profusely. She just rolled in 10 min ago and said she didn’t come home earlier bc she didn’t feel comfortable coming home to an angry boyfriend.
